notes: QA audit top-10 fixes (v1.11.23, report §14): BUG-001 wrong-typed known key in POST /api/state now returns 400 without saving (was silently wiped to default); BUG-002 two-tab state loss — per-box deep merge for done/tests/edits/actualMinutes/tests_total in POST /api/state, un-tick writes false instead of deleting the key, a stale tab's null activeTimer never wipes a running timer (accepted only when the saver banked more real seconds); BUG-008 rollback traversal fixed — the backup name must be one of the listed code backups and the source tree is verified BEFORE the app folder is wiped; BUG-027 stored XSS via subject name in Analytics insights — i.text is now escaped at the sink like i.title; BUG-006 push no longer reports failure for never-linked programme boxes (silent skip; errors stay for boxes that had a mapping and lost it); BUG-007 Dey+ dates render as real Jalali dates everywhere — gregToJalali now builds from jalaliParts in the examDateText/anJalaliText format (fa day digits Persian, «۱۳ آذر ۱۴۰۵», like exam dates already showed); BUG-005 assignment 'go to topic' button works when exam links exist (own class bt-topic-jump, wired in .part-actions); BUG-009 corrupt state/testbook/programme files are preserved as <file>.corrupt-<ts> before any auto-recovery overwrites them, and preserved files are listed in the backup status payload; BUG-003 the _PUSH_IN_FLIGHT guard is released in a finally and bookkeeping failures return an error payload (orphan Google event removed best-effort when the mapping was not persisted); BUG-022 the reconnect absorb guard now also sees usefulMinutes, timerSessions and testLog (errorLog entries carry no box reference, so no per-box check is possible — absorb never deletes errorLog entries). Seq/ETag with 409 was NOT used for BUG-002: it needs client-side conflict resolution that risks the working save flow; the scoped deep-merge fixes the reported repro with no regressions (same-box concurrent edits stay last-writer-wins). Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix is untouched.
